caption:
Back feels tight after the drive to the course? Try this 5-minute reset. 🧘

1. Cobra to Child's Pose: 6 slow reps
2. Bird Dog: 5 each side, 3-second hold
3. Lower Trunk Rotations: 8 each side
Do 2 rounds.

✅ Slow, smooth, pain-free range
❌ Don't push into a pinch

Save this for your next round. Sharp, spreading or lasting back pain? Get it checked.
